Title: Flesh of Marble vs Weather Control

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
Does Flesh of Marble protect you from the increasing damage of Weather Control (limiting it to one damage)? I think not because the word "prevent" is used in flesh of marble and weather control damage is unpreventable.

Weather Control
Combat
Thaumaturgy

Only usable before range is determined on the first round.
[tha] Both combatants and each of their retainers take 1 unpreventable damage before range is determined each round. A vampire may play only one Weather Control each combat.
[THA] As above, but the amount of damage inflicted increases by 1 in each subsequent round.

Flesh of Marble
Combat
Protean

Only usable before range is chosen.
[pro] For the duration of the combat, when this vampire suffers a point of damage (that he or she does not prevent) in a given round, any additional damage inflicted on this vampire in the same round is automatically prevented. Aggravated damage cannot be prevented in this way.
[PRO] As above, but aggravated damage is prevented in this way as well.

Be careful when you fight the monsters, lest you become one.
-Friedrich Nietzsche

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> brandonsantacruz wrote:
> I think not because the word "prevent" is used in flesh of marble and weather control damage is unpreventable.
>
Correct. Flesh of Marble cannot prevent unpreventable damage.
